name: outdoor-rain-full-credit
description: GV-K3 (02k E2): lavender in the ground, establishing, UK loam, full sun. Interval 6; 18 mm of rain on 2026-06-04 is a full credit (15 mm) and moves the window to 06-11 to 06-12.
why: Hand computation in 02k section 3.7, example E2 (interval round(7 x 1.0 x 1.0 x 0.85) = 6, band 2 early and late, anchor 06-07 + 6).
